blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — The Coast Guard Station Occidental Mindoro (CGSOM) has appealed to the public for help locating two fishermen missing after leaving to fish in the waters off Calavite, Paluan, Occidental Mindoro. The missing fishermen were identified as Rolando Rodriguez, 59, and Armando De Ladia, 50, both residents of Sitio Balibago 2, Barangay Armado, Abra de Ilog. According to the CGSOM, the two left Sitio Aroma in Barangay Tayamaan, Mamburao, on Sept. 15 aboard the motorized banca MBCA “King Nonoy” to fish off Calavite.
